page.layout: One page of text, single column, with running head at top and page number at top right. No marginal notes. Signature "c" at the foot.

main_text.p: ἡγεμὼν vel ἡγεμών minister, ἡγεμόνα [?] & ἡγεμονίς ministra.
δότης vel δοτὴρ, δωτὴρ vel δώτωρ dator, δώ-τειρα datrix.
Καρ̀, Καεῖν, & Κάδες Homero, qui vel quæ ex Caria est.
Κίλιξ Κίλισσα, Cilix Cilissa, qui vel quæ ex Cilicia est.
Κρὴς Κρῆσσα, Cres Cressa, qui vel quæ ex Creta est, Cretensis.
βασιλεὺς rex, βασίλισσα, βασίλιννα, βασι-λισσα, βασιλὶς regina.

page.notes: Greek words are printed in a worn, small type; the Greek forms marked [?] (ἡγεμόνα, δεσπότης, the forms beginning "parasitus" and the last two Greek words of the final line) are doubtful. The line "ςαςγίτης" in the scan is damaged and read as γαμέτης by conjecture. The Greek accents of several words are not fully legible.
